EQ 改變「不同頻率的音量」。它不創造聲音，只是把已經存在的頻率重新分配。八段參: EQ changes “the volume of different frequencies”. It does not create sound; it only redistributes frequencies that are already there. Each band of the eight-band parametric EQ has three knobs:
。人聲 80–100 Hz 以下、吉他 80 Hz 以下、鈸 300 Hz 以下: . Below 80–100 Hz on a voice, below 80 Hz on a guitar, below 300 Hz on cymbals, is usually useless noise.
。加法容易造成刺耳，減法要精準。: . Boosting easily makes things harsh; cutting has to be precise.
。覺得「不够亮」時，先看看是不是低頻太多把高頻蓋住了。: . When something feels “not bright enough”, first check whether too much low end is covering the top.
任何濾波器都會改變相位，尤其是 Q 值大的地方，頻率響應上的凹陷兩側會出現相位旋: Every filter changes phase, especially where Q is high: on either side of a dip in the frequency response the phase rotates. What you hear may not be a “phase problem”, but
低切幾乎是萬用第一步: A low cut is almost always step one
先減再想加: Cut first, think about boosting later
八段 EQ 的每一段在做什麼、什麼時候該切、什麼時候該減而不是加。: What each band of the eight-band EQ does, when to cut, and when to subtract rather than add.
切太低的低頻: Cutting the low end too low
加或減多少 dB: how many dB to add or subtract
加的時候用寬的（Q 小），減的時候用窄的（Q 大）: boost wide (low Q), cut narrow (high Q)
圖：EQ 面板：八個頻段的曲線，點的顏色代表不同的濾波形狀。橫軸是頻率，縱軸是增: Figure: the EQ panel: the curves of the eight bands, the colour of each dot showing the filter shape. The horizontal axis is frequency, the vertical axis the dB added or subtracted.
在示範專案的主唱上：低切 90 Hz、250 Hz 減 2 dB（去混濁）、3: On the lead vocal of the demo project: low cut at 90 Hz, cut 2 dB at 250 Hz (to clear the mud), boost 1.5 dB at 3 kHz (for diction); toggle the switch while it plays and compare.
影響範圍有多窄（Q 大＝窄，像手術刀；Q 小＝寬，像大刷子）: how narrow the affected range is (high Q = narrow, like a scalpel; low Q = wide, like a big brush)
把某頻率以下全部砍掉，: cuts away everything below a frequency,
會讓聲音變薄、變得不自然。這就是「用減法做 EQ」比較好聽的原因。: makes the sound thin and unnatural. That is why “EQ by subtraction” sounds better.
